what: 3,432 dots (1,144 on phone) pinned behind the screen gather from their initial scattered positions into a sphere (radius 298, ×.7 on phone) over 2s cubic-out and rotate at .16rad per second. Picking a shape with fx:shape moves each dot toward it by .05 per frame (.06 for sphere↔plane mixing) into a rippling plane (1560×860, tilted .42rad forward), torus (.1rad per second), tube twisted 2.6 turns (.22rad per second), breathing concentric rings (.05rad per second), cube lattice (.14rad per second) or heartbeat heart (1.05 beats/s, 5%). For torus, tube, cube and heart the dot color shifts along from the text color to the opposite stage’s text color (for dark sections), and dot size, opacity and tilt also change per shape using the original values (three ShaderMaterial — mixing and rotating shapes run in the vertex shader)

options.fx:shape: On the element, CustomEvent('fx:shape', { detail: { shape } }) sends it and they gather into that shape — the caller sends it per section with ScrollTrigger
options.dark: Shapes that pass the dot color as --fx-dot-dark (space separated), default torus tube cube heart — shapes for sections where the background turns dark
options.lerp: Share of approach between shapes (per frame), default .05
options.morph-lerp: Sphere ↔ plate blend share (per frame), default .06
options.intro: Duration of gathering from the initial scatter (sec), default 2 — 0 snaps straight into a sphere
options.cols · rows: Dot grid cell count, default 78×44 (phone, short side under 760: 44×26)
options.radius: Sphere radius (world units, camera distance 720, FOV 55°), default 298
options.--fx-dot · --fx-dot-dark: Dot color for light and dark sections (via style), default --kf-ink · --kf-contrast-ink
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (selector) — if none, one is created inside the element

note: The original moved point coordinates in JS every frame and gave PointsMaterial a circular gradient image. The same formula was moved to the vertex shader and the dot pattern is computed in the fragment shader (center 1 → half radius .85 → edge 0). The heart is picked randomly inside the curve like the original. It is a per-frame lerp, so a faster display refresh approaches faster, as in the original. Stops off screen and in hidden tabs. With reduced motion it does not spin and stands directly at the chosen shape. The user sets the element to position: fixed; Set inset: 0 and lay it behind the body copy (z-index 0)

from.where: index.html .g-bg (original #bg canvas + assets/bg.js) — per section: hero sphere · intro panel · service donut · approach tube · plan concentric circles · why cube · field heart, dots turn ivory on dark sections
